Features

Infrastructure that
remembers what counts.

Four systems in one API. Each one invisible to your LLM, each one critical to your bill.

Classify

Domain & Intent Detection

DistilBERT fine-tuned on 10 domains — coding, medical, legal, sales, customer support. Runs on CPU. Returns domain, intent, risk level, emotional state per turn. No LLM call.

<10msper classification
Compress

T5 History Compression

T5 removes noise while preserving semantic meaning. Stack traces compress well. Medical history doesn't — by design. Compression is domain-aware, not uniform.

64.7%avg token reduction
Cache

Semantic Similarity Cache

MiniLM embeddings catch semantically equivalent questions before they reach the compressor. Returning users skip reprocessing entirely. Savings compound.

Sub-5mscache lookup per turn
Protect

Protected Zones

Medical, legal, and crisis conversations are never compressed, never monetized. Not a filter — an architectural boundary. If the classifier returns medical, compression is disabled at the function level.

Hard floorno compression · no ads · no leakage
Integration

One line.
Any model.

Drop-in OpenAI-compatible proxy. Change your baseURL — nothing else. Works with GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
